_about: Context & Memory rows (settings audit, 2026-09-27). Settings has no open chat (user review, 2026-09-27): rows name what every chat does, and Squeeze now reads as a thing each chat's own menu does.

memory.retention.enabled.label: Remember things between chats
memory.retention.enabled.help: Off stops saving and using memories. Your saved notes stay available to edit or delete.

general.interaction.context-usage.label: Show a space meter in each chat
general.interaction.context-usage.help: A small meter in each chat shows how full its working space is.

memory.limits.manual-compact.label: Squeeze one chat now
memory.limits.manual-compact.help: Each chat's own menu has Squeeze now: it summarizes that chat's older part at once, for that chat only.

memory.limits.max-context-ktokens.label: Largest working space
memory.limits.max-context-ktokens.help: In thousands of tokens; capped to what the model allows.
memory.limits.max-context-ktokens.placeholder: As large as the model allows

memory.assembly.app-rules.label: Rules for every project
memory.assembly.app-rules.help: Standing instructions every run reads, everywhere.
